reviews.text: Based on the playtest, it's a simpler version of REPO that was clearly inspired by cartoons like SpongeBob and The Marvelous Misadventures of Flapjack.
A 4-player co-op horror game where players take on the roles of pirates exploring cursed islands to collect loot while facing supernatural threats
Co-op horror, pirate greed and stretchy arms. Grab loot, raid the island, dodge monsters and hope at least one player gets the treasure back to the ship. Chaotic in the best way.

Stretchy-arm treasure hunting turns every expedition into a disaster in the best way, especially with friends. Great for co-op fans who enjoy horror, loot, and constant goofing around. - KillshotKitty
Weekend game, streamer game, friendslop, lethal-like, and will likely be dead in weeks. Affiliated with Jestr.gg who pays streamers to play the game. No. More. Friendslop.
DEI Free | Ukrainian indie co-op pirate horror with no documented DEI elements, consultants, or ideological content in the demo or developer record.
Funny co-op, though I did find it a bit hard but it's possible we just rlly sucked at it or that it might be better with 4 players then two. Who knows. Still fun(ny) though.
An independent video game development and art outsourcing studio based in Kyiv, Ukraine. Founded in Kyiv in 2010. The game is entirely funded, developed, and distributed via UA and USA channels
